text:
nora: Seeing a sudden uptick in tiny-gpu pod Pending->Evicted in ap-southeast1 since 10:15 UTC. Common pattern: long CSI attach, then scheduler preempts and spreads.
infra-bot: ALERT gpu_attach_errors ap-southeast1 count=15 window=8m top_reason=rpc_timeout
sam: Can we get events for one pod? `kubectl describe pod gpu-lite-92 -n research`
raj: event snippet pasted:
```
Events:
  Normal  Scheduled  4m  default-scheduler  Successfully assigned research/gpu-lite-92 to node-ap-se-7
  Warning FailedAttachVolume 3m  attach-detacher  AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "pvc-99" : rpc timeout after 45s
  Warning  Failed 2m  kubelet  Evicted: Preemption: higher priority pod
```
sre-oncall: Initial guess: network egress saturation on warm-pool hosts + CSI driver holding stale sessions. Mitigations I can run now: 1) rotate CSI controller on 4 nodes (staggered), 2) increase warm-pool by +25% for 45m, 3) set preemption grace to 90s in ap-southeast1. Which first?
nora: Rotate CSI controller + warm pool bump. Avoid affinity changes unless necessary.
sam: Writing quick PromQL to validate correlation: `sum(rate(csi_attach_duration_seconds_count{region="ap-southeast1"}[5m])) by (status)` and `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(csi_attach_duration_seconds_bucket{region="ap-southeast1"}[5m])) by (le))`
raj: p99 attach ~130s last 10m, attach errors up. Host egress tx drops on pool-nodes show qdisc drops at same time windows.
sre-oncall: Executed warm-pool bump (12 -> 15) and CSI controller rotation on nodes ap-se-6/7/8/9. Monitoring.
infra-bot: Incident INC-2024-846 created for ap-southeast1 attach surge
sam: Also we see strict anti-affinity label `gpu:exclusive=true` on many tiny-gpu deployments, causing scheduler to spread when attach stalls. If attach hangs, scheduler cannot pack and tries other nodes -> fragmentation.
nora: Let's avoid toggling affinity globally. If mitigation needed, we can flip `requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` -> `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` for one canary ns.
raj: Suggest canary scheduler scoring plugin to prefer packing tiny pods: +12 score if node has >=0.5 free GPU and same PCI group. Will deploy to canary namespace.
sre-oncall: Canary scoring plugin deployed to ml-canary. Observed packing density improvement ~28% within 6m on canary. Evictions on canary reduced.
sam: Long-term proposals: 1) increase CSI attach timeout to 120s cluster-wide (RFC), 2) autoscaler to maintain extra warm capacity during APAC business hours, 3) scheduler plugin for gang/packing preferences for tiny-gpu jobs.
raj: I'll open RFC draft (1743201240) for attach-timeout + packing plugin with rollout/backout plan.
infra-bot: ACTION created: runbook task 'rotate-csi-controller' assigned to eng-oncall
sre-oncall: Follow-ups: add Prometheus alert for `csi_attach_p99 > 45s for 5m` to page SRE, add metric `packing_density{az}` (pods_per_gpu_node) to track fragmentation.
nora: After the bump+rotation+canary scoring, pending count dropped ~50% in 12m and evictions nearly stopped. Keeping warm pool elevated for 1h.
sam: We'll schedule a short postmortem tomorrow; root cause likely intermittent egress saturation causing long RPC attach latencies amplified by strict anti-affinity and short preemption thresholds.
raj: Thanks team. I'll link RFC and postmortem invite. :thumbsup:
